frames.description: Item 1 (wt: 2, val: 3). Capacities w < 2 cannot take item. Capacities >= 2 store 3.
frames.invariants: Base transition: dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], dp[i-1][w-wt] + val)

frames.description: Item 2 (wt: 3, val: 4). At capacity w=4, can include Item 2 (wt 3) + Item 1 (wt 1 impossible).
frames.invariants: Compare excluding item 2 (val 3) vs including item 2 (val 4) -> Choose 4

frames.description: Item 3 (wt: 1, val: 2). At capacity w=4: take Item 3 (wt 1) + Item 2 (wt 3) = val 6! Optimal!
frames.invariants: Optimal solution: total value 6 with weight 4
